user.title: Connect to Swtch EV Charger
user.description: Enter the charger's IP address and polling settings.

password.title: Charger admin password
password.description: The field is pre-filled with the factory password the charger web interface uses. If you changed the admin password, enter yours instead. The integration logs in and renews its token automatically.

password_not_found.title: Charger admin password
password_not_found.description: Couldn't read the factory password from the charger web interface. Enter the charger's admin password; the README explains how to find the factory password. The integration logs in and renews its token automatically.

calibrate.title: Match the charger app (optional)
calibrate.description: Enter the total energy in kWh that the charger app shows right now, so the Energy sensor reads the same, for past, current and future charging. Leave it empty to use the raw meter value.

reauth_confirm.title: Charger requires a password
reauth_confirm.description: The charger now requires the admin password (for example after a firmware update). Enter it to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the charger
error.invalid_response: The charger returned an invalid response
error.no_meter: The charger reported no meter reading to calibrate against; try again in a moment

init.title: Swtch EV Charger options
init.description: Update the admin password and polling settings. Leave the password empty for chargers on older firmware that needs no login. To match the charger app, enter the kWh it shows right now; leave that empty to keep the current calibration.

data.reset_energy_calibration: Remove the energy calibration (use the raw meter)

error.no_meter: The charger reported no meter reading to calibrate against; try again in a moment
